The prototype has never been served to a customer.","locator":"Offline ranking evaluation (February 2026)"},"summary":"The same record reports a measured NDCG@10 gain of 0.06 for learned ranking and, immediately after, states the evaluation is circular because it is scored against position-biased clicks from the incumbent ranker. cause_category: synonym_gap
catalogue_status: stocked as drywall panel","locator":"zero result queries row 1"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-8c6f532a","quote":"Those eighteen terms account for 7.3% of zero-result search volume in the quarter. search_count: 17250
cause_category: not_stocked
catalogue_status: discontinued 2025-Q3 with no substitute mapped","locator":"zero result queries row 7"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-76865d91","quote":"query_term: house wire 12 2

cause_category: attribute_query

metric: search_session_share
value: 11.0
unit: percent
segment: trade_account","locator":"search metrics row 25"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-8873548a","quote":"period: 2026-Q2
metric: search_revenue_share
value: 34.0
unit: percent
segment: trade_account","locator":"search metrics row 26"},"summary":"Both true of the same segment measured two ways. Sizing the recoverable revenue behind the 16.4% trade zero-result rate would settle which segment the intervention should target."},{"id":"C14","topic":"Interview evidence on abandonment: strength vs recruitment bias","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-8c6f532a","quote":"Nine trade customers were interviewed. Eight of the nine said they abandon the site when their term returns nothing and either telephone the trade counter or buy elsewhere.","locator":"Trade terminology interviews (March 2026)"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-8c6f532a","quote":"Participants were recruited at the trade counters of two stores, so every one of them already shops with us in person.","locator":"Trade terminology interviews (March 2026)"},"summary":"The 8-of-9 abandonment finding is the strongest qualitative support for treating zero results as the priority, and the same record states the sample was recruited exclusively at trade counters, which selects for customers who have an in-person fallback and therefore for the 'telephone the trade counter' behaviour reported. UX research itself asks that it be treated as a hypothesis and not a number.","how_to_resolve":"Re-recruit from digital-only trade accounts and from sessions that ended at a zero-result page, then re-measure abandonment."},{"id":"C15","topic":"Synonym pilot conversion lift: measured movement vs unattributable to the change","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-8c6f532a","quote":"Search-to-cart conversion on that storefront moved from 11.8% in the four weeks before the pilot to 12.3% during it.","locator":"Synonym mapping pilot — secondary storefront"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-8c6f532a","quote":"There was no holdout group. The pilot ran across the holiday trading peak, when search-to-cart conversion rises on both storefronts every year. The conversion movement cannot be separated from the season.","locator":"Synonym mapping pilot — secondary storefront"},"summary":"The synonym pilot's headline conversion gain of 0.5pp and its own invalidation appear in the same record. The zero-result reduction for the 120 mapped terms (100% to 3.2%) is a direct measurement of the mechanism; the conversion figure is confounded by holiday seasonality with no holdout.","how_to_resolve":"Re-run synonym expansion on the primary storefront with a randomised holdout outside the trading peak. Synonym updates are exempt from the code freeze, so this can run during Q4."},{"id":"C16","topic":"Deliverability of the ranking re-platform inside H2","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-843a50ab","quote":"Approve the ranking re-platform for delivery in H2 2026. Decision requested at the August planning review.","locator":"Slide 7 — Ask"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-aab2655b","quote":"Building a vector index requires embedding all 1.2 million SKUs and operating a GPU serving tier, which we do not run today. Engineering has not estimated the work.","locator":"Re-platform"},"summary":"The slides request approval for H2 delivery. Platform engineering states the work is unestimated and needs infrastructure not currently operated; the roadmap's own open items say effort is not estimated and a discovery spike is requested before any date is committed. The storefront code freeze from 2026-10-15 to 2027-01-05 also removes most of H2's remaining shipping window.","how_to_resolve":"Complete Nadia's two-week discovery spike and produce an estimate, then test it against the freeze window and the FY26 platform spend cap before any delivery date is approved."},{"id":"C17","topic":"Ranking approach vs governance and merchandising requirements","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-7ad64618","quote":"I am asking the Search and Discovery team to plan a ranking re-platform for H2 — learned ranking over a vector index — with a recommendation ready for the August planning review.","locator":"What I want"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-bdf52db3","quote":"Any automated system that determines which products a customer is shown must carry a documented description of its ranking factors, reviewable by merchandising on request. This applies to learned ranking models and there is no exemption for model complexity.","locator":"Automated ranking transparency"},"summary":"The requested intervention is a learned ranking model. Governance requires documented, merchandising-reviewable ranking factors with no complexity exemption, requires manual pin and demote overrides to be preserved, and caps personalised ranking at 22% consent coverage. Neither the memo nor the slides addresses these constraints.","how_to_resolve":"Have legal-privacy review the proposed architecture against the transparency, override and consent requirements before the August decision, and confirm whether any new vendor triggers the eight-to-ten-week assessment."},{"id":"C18","topic":"Vendor conversion-lift claim vs internal measurement capability","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-843a50ab","quote":"Thurlow Discovery Labs reports a 22% lift in search conversion for retail clients after deploying its ranking service.","locator":"Slide 6 — Market"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-16f9f013","quote":"synthetic - never populated; no human relevance judgement set exists and no query has ever been scored for relevance","locator":"search metrics row 27"},"summary":"A vendor-reported 22% conversion lift is offered as market evidence for ranking. Internally there is no relevance judgement set, no online ranking A/B test and no measurement of ranking quality, so the organisation has no baseline against which a vendor lift could be verified or replicated. The roadmap concedes there is no measurement of ranking quality to set a target against.","how_to_resolve":"Request the vendor's methodology, baseline and client population, and establish an internal relevance baseline before treating the 22% figure as applicable."},{"id":"C19","topic":"Whether catalogue and attribute work is a viable path","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-7ad64618","quote":"I have not seen a relevance analysis and I do not think we need one to know this. We have spent two years tidying product data and the conversion line has gone backwards.","locator":"What I want"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-aab2655b","quote":"Only 41% of SKUs have structured size or dimension attributes populated. Attribute-filtered search cannot be built on the current data.","locator":"Catalogue data"},"summary":"The memo dismisses catalogue work on the grounds that two years of it coincided with falling conversion. Platform engineering records that structured attributes are populated for only 41% of SKUs, and three of the eighteen head zero-result terms are attribute queries against unsearchable fields — so the catalogue data is not in a state where the attribute path has been tried and failed.","how_to_resolve":"Separate 'catalogue tidying already done' from 'attribute coverage still missing'. Establish what share of zero-result volume is attribute-driven before ruling the catalogue path out."},{"id":"C20","topic":"Synonym expansion below the line vs synonym gap as leading categorised cause","kind":"claim_conflict","side_a":{"evidence_id":"EV-a2654f30","quote":"| 2 | Synonym dictionary expansion | catalogue operations | continues at current staffing, below the line |","locator":"H2 candidates"},"side_b":{"evidence_id":"EV-38366396","quote":"The synonym file is a flat file maintained by two people. The backlog is 1,900 unmapped terms and it grows faster than we clear it.","locator":"Round the room — Dev Achterberg"},"summary":"The roadmap holds synonym expansion below the line at current staffing because it does not act on ranking. Catalogue operations states that at current staffing the 1,900-term backlog grows faster than it is cleared, so 'continues at current staffing' means the gap widens. Synonym gap is meanwhile the most frequent assigned cause among the eighteen categorised head terms, and synonym updates are exempt from the Q4 code freeze.","how_to_resolve":"Cost the throughput needed to clear the backlog and model the zero-result reduction against the 9.2% restated rate, then compare that against the unestimated re-platform on the same basis."}]}

The relevance_judged_queries field is present in the metrics set and was never populated, and analytics states explicitly that every findability measure published is a measure of searches that returned nothing. Without any measurement of ignored-but-non-empty results, the ranking hypothesis is unmeasured and unfalsified, and the alternative (coverage/synonym/spell/attribute gaps) has the only quantified evidence. A half-year commitment would be made to an untested premise.","how_to_obtain":"Build a human-judged relevance set: sample stratified queries from the restated typed-and-submitted series, have merchandising and catalogue operations rate top-10 results per query, and compute a baseline relevance metric. Also instrument result-set abandonment (searches returning results with no click or no cart add). Both are pre-work, not a re-platform.","was_searched":true},{"id":"GAP-002","question":"What is the engineering effort, elapsed time and cost of the ranking re-platform (embedding 1.2M SKUs, standing up a GPU serving tier)?","impact":"would_change_recommendation","why_it_matters":"No figure has ever been produced — the roadmap records the estimate as open and platform engineering states the work has not been estimated. Platform spend is capped at the FY26 approved figure with no net new headcount, so a candidate whose cost is unknown cannot be shown to fit inside the limit, and cannot be shown to land before the 2026-10-15 storefront code freeze. A large number would make the option infeasible this half-year regardless of its merits.","how_to_obtain":"Complete the two-week discovery spike already actioned to Nadia Fenwick and require a costed estimate (build effort, GPU serving run-rate, embedding pipeline cost) before the August planning review.","was_searched":true},{"id":"GAP-003","question":"What are the causes of the remaining 92.7% of zero-result search volume that has never been categorised?","impact":"would_change_scope","why_it_matters":"Hand review covered only the eighteen highest-volume terms, which account for 7.3% of zero-result volume in 2026-Q2. Nothing is known about whether the tail resembles the head.
